ideas.title: Debt-Convoy
ideas.core_fantasy: The player inhabits this premise: a power is designed with at least one encounter use, one out-of-encounter use, and one delayed surprising use so it changes both tactics and story routes.
player_loop: Read a concrete situation shaped by multi-use power mutation.
Choose how to interpret the pressure through contact-to-duel handoff.
Spend, gain, or contaminate one visible state axis.
Let multi-use power mutation alter the next draw or route.
Resolve a later echo that proves the previous choice mattered.
signature_systems: Touch lane combat with buffered intent: make block/cancel windows a player-facing rule, not just lore.
Contact-to-duel handoff: make duel camera a player-facing rule, not just lore.
Multi-use power mutation: make identity shift a player-facing rule, not just lore.
Pose lab animation retargeting: make skeleton profile a production constraint with a visible review or validation step.
content_pipeline: Start from pose lab animation retargeting.
Keep prose, mechanics, and validation as separate artifacts.
Accept content only when choices produce readable state changes and later consequences.
prototype_scope: Two resource axes and one delayed consequence queue.
One review command that prints why each event was selected.
validation_plan: Create a tiny schema for rooms/events/actions before writing content.
Generate 6-10 sample records and run an action-ID/dangling-reference audit.
Build one review surface or CLI output that shows state before and after each choice.
Prototype the riskiest piece first: Single-purpose upgrade.
design_questions: How does the camera show commitment?
How can motion be compared across clips?
What does it contaminate or reveal later?
What does this power solve immediately?
